scope: unweighted dcv_el/tight on variation shard 1. 3D Bayesian phi_h, 452 fitted cells, Q2-y 1-17. RC_Bayesian, BC_RC_Bayesian, and 5D are absent and were not created. No publication.
start_mode: manual. Spline B windows are tight (median width 0.020, 945 of 1390 narrower than 0.05), so --use_spline_init was not used. Changed bins are in refine_init.py, a copy of nominal_init.py.
changed: Initial run_shard was not treated as finished. 15 bins were trapped by a small first-pass moment start: the second pass only moves a parameter halfway, so A(1+B cos phi+C cos 2phi) was too flat. Starts were moved to the histogram cosine and limits that excluded it were widened in refine_init.py. Remade Q2-y 1 2 3 7 10 11 13 14 15 with --unfolding_3D --fit_corrections Bayesian --fit_error_source histogram --fit_init_file, no pass cap and no chi-squared stop. All 15 improved. Worst (3,16) 16.55 to 1.36. Other cells in those Q2-y bins did not move, and unselected Q2-y bins are unchanged. JSON still has 452 cells. The shared manual initializer and the universal spline file were not edited.
left_bins: No 5D family, so nothing was left from a 3D-versus-5D disagreement. Histogram shapes that disagree with a neighbor were kept, including (13,10) B -0.356 beside neighbor -0.014; (15,15) B -0.326 beside neighbor -0.014; (3,24) B -0.305 beside neighbor -0.033; (11,20) B -0.292 beside neighbor -0.032.
unresolved: The best three-parameter curve still misses the histogram in (1,32) 5.98, (1,7) 5.14, (12,24) 4.66, (1,9) failed_rule. Further guide changes do not help those bins. Empty histograms stay N/A and are not zeroes. (1,9) still has parameter errors of 0 with B and C at 0; the free cosine is the same shape, so the guide was not retuned.
